findings.finding: impl-03 selftest is RED against installed engines (9 FAIL + ABORT, rc=1); certifiable-as-is = NO.

impl-S12 stages dirty tracked files (engine-only gate): uncommitted work would be quarantined and releasable to deletion under a pushed receipt. Needs a gate2/dirty pre-flight (impl-01's porcelain preflight or 02/03's gate2).

impl-01 has no origin-resurrection pin: with the original path recreated mid-hold its second check passes (pin=ok mtime=ok intro-blob=ok) and it deletes the quarantine copy anyway. 02/03/S12 all catch resurrection (gate2-regressed / original-reappeared / origin-recreated).

impl-03's two second-check surfaces disagree: verify-staged HOLDs tracked-class staging forever (reads its own plain-mv deletion as gate2 regression) while retire ignores that check and RETIREs. Also no hold-duration enforcement at all.

impl-02 refuses every mutating op outside tmpdir (sandbox-not-under-tmpdir, impl-02.sh:491-494); proven blocking on /home, and /tmp suffered a per-user quota outage during this same round (13G/16G, sibling seats) that made /tmp fixture work impossible mid-run. A tmpdir-sited quarantine tool is fragile exactly when /tmp is stressed; TMPDIR=<fixture> is a proven workaround.

untracked stale candidates are unclassifiable for impl-02/03 unless IGNORED (porcelain '??' trips gate2): a pushed .gitignore covering the scratch family is the enabling precondition. qrun-13's F6 gate2-wording fix is necessary but not sufficient at tool level — the runbook must state the ignored-file precondition for the plain-mv flow.

Engines classify a TRACKED file with a draft/checkpoint name as PUSHED (receipt priority), not stale — 'tracked stale' scenarios exercise the pushed second-check path, and mid-hold live-ref injection cannot break a pushed receipt. True stale-class tickets require untracked (see F6) or .scratch-dir components.

Mid-hold receipt-break is caught by 3 of 4 impls (01 ABORT+retain, 02 verify-FAIL+refuse, S12 check-FAIL rc5+refuse+restore); origin-recreation by 3 of 4 (02, 03, S12 — each with a distinct reason class); secrets/too-young/unpushed/no-remote refused by all four.

impl-S12's LIVE-TREE-LOCKED allow-list lock fires even when --root is inside the fixture and only the allow env is missing; S12 is the only impl with an explicit lock, 02's analog is the signoff+tmpdir pair, 03's is signoff+sandbox, 01 has none (quarantine-path-only rm by construction).
